verdict.rationale: CrewAI ships official skills and a ready-to-paste setup prompt so coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor can drive CrewAI work. Agents and tasks are also defined through natural-language role, goal, and description fields. However, natural-language operation runs through an external coding agent, and the product's own interfaces are code, the CLI, or the visual and no-code builders rather than a native natural-language command surface. Missing for 10: a native natural-language command interface for creating, running, and managing crews; documentation of what the CrewAI skills can do; and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Copy a ready-to-paste setup prompt for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or any coding agent. It installs the official CrewAI skills, checks the CLI, and points the agent at the right docs before it edits code.
A clear, concise statement of what the task entails.
